selection: every record whose meta.pile_set_name is "Github", in file order, its text encoded UTF-8 and followed by one newline byte, concatenated and truncated to 100,000,000 bytes; the file holds 18,337 such records and 97,124,565 bytes, so nothing is truncated
train_batch_schedule: step k zero-based, row b: bytes[(k*batch*2048 + b*2048) % (97124565 - 2049) : start+2049]; targets shifted one byte (tools/lm_step_memory_probe.py --corpus, tools/torch_lm_step_opponent.py)

benchmark.name: the Pile, GitHub component, byte-level language modeling
benchmark.metric: bits per byte on the Pile test split's GitHub records (the same selection applied to test.jsonl.zst of the same revision, sha256 a6cafe820e9c350af95b57ec75d35d7c8b479de2eb87caabe6fb6b567e639c3a)
benchmark.published: GPT-2 small 1.7912 and GPT-3 davinci 0.5635 (Gao et al., arXiv 2101.00027); byte-level Transformer 0.655, MegaByte 0.570, SpaceByte 0.500 (arXiv 2404.14408)

scope: source-code kind for the two-corpus neural rule (ENGINEERING_RULES section 9, from 2026-09-11 night); the source is the Pile validation file, used here as training bytes for timing; input.txt is fetched by tools/fetch_corpus_pile_github.sh and is not committed
